label: Rigid
def: Objects that move without visibly deforming: blocks, balls, tools, containers.

label: Articulated
def: Bodies linked by joints or hinges: robot arms and grippers, chains, gears and linkages, pendulums, wheels on axles.

label: Elastic
def: Soft matter that deforms and springs back: rubber, jelly, springs, soft toys, inflatables.

label: Plastic
def: Matter that keeps its new shape: dough, clay, crushed metal, cream, putty, snow.

label: Granular
def: Many small grains flowing as a bulk: sand, rice, beans, cereal, coffee beans.

label: Liquid
def: Flowing fluid, thick ones included: water, honey, syrup, wine, milk, melted chocolate.

label: Co-dimensional
def: Thin sheets and strands: cloth, paper, rope, string, hair, noodles, thin shells.

label: Single “matter”
def: The dynamics involve one body of one material (static scenery aside).

label: Many single “matter”
def: Many separate bodies, all of the same material: dominoes, marbles, pins, stacked blocks.

label: Multi-“matter”
def: Two or more materials interact: liquid in a rigid cup, cloth handled by a robot, a ball hitting sand.

label: Fracture
def: Something breaks, tears, is cut, splits or shatters.

label: Scripted
def: Some motion is prescribed rather than physical: a hand, robot, press or tool moving along a set path.

label: Large deformation
def: Shapes change a lot: folding, squashing, stretching, pouring, collapsing heaps.

label: Transient
def: A short, fast event such as an impact, splash, collapse or snap, rather than a steady or slow process.
